notes: The kaleyra.com/careers/ ledger URL redirects to the Tata Communications parent board, so this schema documents Kaleyra's company-scoped FreshTeam board. The listing form is GET /jobs/search with query (keyword), branch_id (location), and remote (workplace). A live request query=engineer&branch_id=2000006306&remote=1 returned 'No jobs found', confirming the parameters are applied natively. Department headings and employment labels are display-only, not filters.
